newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shum Yip says HK part of IPO 438 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Shum Yip says HK part of IPO 438 times subscribed.

text.p: Shenzhen municipal government backed Shum Yip Investment Ltd said the 30 percent of its initial public offering (IPO) that is being offered to Hong Kong retail investors was 438 times subscribed.
Shum Yip initially issued 250 million shares at HK$1.85 per share, of which 175 million shares were for international placing and 75 million shares for public offer in Hong Kong.

The company said it received application for a total 29.54 billion shares compared with 67.5 million shares available for public subscription in Hong Kong. Another 7.5 million shares reserved for employee were fully allotted.
Shum Yip said its global coordinator Peregrine Capital Ltd had exercised an option to require the company to issue an additional 37.50 million shares to cover overallotment.
Trading in Shum Yip shares is expected to begin on March 7.

Shum Yip, a flagship vehicle of the Shenzhen Muncipal government to be listed in Hong Kong, engages in property development and investment primarily in Shenzhen in China across the border from Hong Kong. It also provides transportation services in China, and between Hong Kong and China.
